newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Leading Spirit plans spinoff.
newsitem.headline: Leading Spirit plans spinoff.

text.p: Leading Spirit (Holdings) Co Ltd said on Thursday it planned to spin off its interests in various electrical home appliances operations.

The company said in a statement it would transfer its interests in various units involved in the design, manufacture, assembly and sale of electrical home appliances and the distribution of parts and components to a subsidiary.
It said an application had been made to the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong for a separate listing of the subsidiary.
Leading Spirit shares closed at HK$1.78 on Wednesday.
